issue:
ResilienceHub list_app_assessments API not working with moto API backend

When trying to use the moto API backend to set resilience assessment results, the functionality is broken. The API endpoint for setting resilience results has been removed, but the test still expects it to work.

```python
import boto3
import requests
import json

# Try to set up resilience assessment results
summary1 = {"appArn": "app_arn1", "appVersion": "some version"}
summary2 = {"appArn": "app_arn2"}
results = {"results": [[summary1, summary2]], "region": "us-east-1"}

# This endpoint no longer exists
resp = requests.post(
    "http://motoapi.amazonaws.com/moto-api/static/resilience-hub-assessments/response",
    json=results,
)

# This will fail because the endpoint is missing
client = boto3.client("resiliencehub", region_name="us-east-1")
resp = client.list_app_assessments()
```

The API endpoint for setting resilience results is missing, and the backend implementation for handling assessment results has been removed.
